descriptor: AI agents that automate repetitive work

voice.summary: Sounds like a smart colleague explaining automation without jargon: calm, optimistic and specific about busywork. It promises time back for what matters and avoids sci-fi hype.
dos: Name the busywork being removed, such as follow-ups
Use verbs like learn, adapt and execute
Keep the CTA to two or three words
donts: Do not say replace your team
Do not use sci-fi or doom language
Do not use unexplained AI terms

taglines: Automation that works while you don't
Your team, free for what matters
boilerplate: Nexora builds intelligent agents that learn, adapt and execute repetitive tasks so teams can spend their time on the work that matters most.

microcopy.success: Agent created. It's learning your workflow.
microcopy.error: The agent couldn't run. Please retry.
microcopy.empty: No agents yet. Create your first.

logo.note: A spark shows an intelligent assistant and fits the star in the page's logo.
